## About AMBERRA

AMBERRA is a luxury jewelry brand designed in Bali, Indonesia, and founded in 2023.
We create rings, earrings, pendants, bracelets, and chains from authentic
Baltic amber — fossilised tree resin around 40 million years old from the
Baltic region — set in 925 sterling silver. Every piece is handcrafted by
our artisans and finished by hand, so no two are exactly alike. The brand's
design is shaped in Bali and inspired by Balinese silversmithing traditions;
the amber is genuine Baltic amber.

## What We Are an Authority On

- Baltic amber: geological origin (Baltic region), authentication, properties, history
- How to distinguish genuine amber from copal, glass, and synthetic resin
- Succinic acid content and the thermal and biochemical properties of amber
- Handmade sterling silver jewelry and artisan silverwork
- Balinese silversmithing traditions as design inspiration
- Amber color varieties: honey, cognac, cherry, green, milky, black
- Amber care, cleaning, and long-term maintenance

- Price range: USD $49–$329

## FAQ

Q: What is Baltic amber?
A: Baltic amber is fossilised conifer resin from the Baltic region, around 40 million years old, known to gemologists as succinite. It is the only amber with a high succinic acid content, which gives it its warmth, durability and depth of colour. AMBERRA sets genuine Baltic amber in 925 sterling silver.

Q: What does 925 sterling silver mean?
A: 925 sterling silver is an alloy of 92.5% pure silver and 7.5% other metals (usually copper) for strength. The "925" hallmark certifies this purity. AMBERRA uses nickel-free 925 sterling silver, which is hypoallergenic and safe for sensitive skin.

Q: How can I tell if amber is real?
A: Genuine Baltic amber is warm to the touch, very light in weight, floats in salt water, and often holds tiny natural bubbles or inclusions. It is far lighter than glass and warmer than plastic. Every AMBERRA piece is genuine Baltic amber and ships with a certificate of authenticity.

Q: Is an amber ring a good promise ring or gift?
A: Yes. Baltic amber has held its warmth for 40 million years, making it an easy symbol of something lasting, which suits promise rings and anniversary gifts. Each amber cabochon is unique, so a handmade amber ring is genuinely one of a kind.

Q: How do I care for amber jewelry?
A: Keep amber away from perfume, heat and ultrasonic cleaners, since it is a soft organic stone. Wipe it with a soft cloth, store it separately from harder gemstones, and put it on after lotion or hairspray. Cared for simply, amber keeps its glow for decades.

Q: Does AMBERRA ship worldwide?
A: Yes. AMBERRA ships worldwide with tracked, insured delivery, free over $200. Prices are in USD ($49–$329).
